entries.prompt: Create a FINAL photorealistic background for a MOBILE MEMORIAL APP, reauthored as a very tall portrait image. INPUT 1 is a geometric layout guide ONLY; use its exact tall canvas and placement zones. INPUT 2 is a previous style reference; preserve its cultural material family but REDESIGN the composition for the tall phone. Output canvas must match INPUT 1: 1024x2220 pixels, approximately 393:852 / 9:19.5 aspect, full-bleed opaque artwork. DO NOT use the old reference's wider 3:4 aspect or a panoramic composition. Camera centered, level, frontal, one consistent architectural perspective. Unified restrained photo-realistic material finish and soft natural upper-right light across the four country variants. IMPORTANT MOBILE COMPOSITION: culture-defining architectural details occupy the visible side bands x=4%..22% and78%..96%, y=18%..60%, so they are seen NEXT TO a centered portrait. Keep the central x=25%..75%, y=6%..54% a quiet low-detail EMPTY wall for the app's name, portrait and epitaph. No baked-in portrait/frame/title/plaque. Maintain calm title space y=6%..16%, portrait space y=19%..47%, epitaph space y=48%..54%. Wall-to-floor junction at about y=66%; bottom34% is open floor for a separate table and candles layered by the app. Do not place a table or foreground object in the background. There must be visible architecture both sides of the wall, not a nearly featureless full-width blank wall. ALL outline boxes and flat colored blocks from input1 are GUIDE MARKS ONLY: REMOVE them completely in the finished artwork. No outlines around the portrait zone, no picture frame, no people, no flowers, no candles, no incense, no furniture, no bowls, no memorial symbols, no text, calligraphy, banners, flags, statues or religious emblems. This is a dignified, quiet remembrance space. Chinese remembrance hall: deep warm mahogany architectural wood, refined Chinese rectangular lattice window panels in the LEFT and RIGHT SIDE BANDS, two small warm cream Chinese lanterns hanging high at x~12% and88%, y~10% to18%, and understated horizontal wooden lintels. No long dangling tassels. Center a restrained dark warm wooden wall. A polished but not glossy medium warm oak plank floor. Clearly Chinese woodcraft and geometric lattice details visible beside the portrait area, never relegated to an off-canvas edge. No calligraphy or landscape scrolls.

Create a FINAL transparent TABLE SPRITE for a mobile memorial app, unified in perspective and geometry across country variants. INPUT 1 is a geometric silhouette guide ONLY and dictates the EXACT output canvas and surface positions. INPUT 2 is an earlier style/material reference. Output 1024x512 pixels, exact 2:1 canvas, straight-on symmetrical front view with slight view down onto both surfaces, level horizon. True transparent alpha background and transparent openings behind/between the legs and shelves; no floor or cast shadow outside the table. Use input1's footprint and TWO surfaces precisely: full table width x=2%..98%, top rear edge y=17%, tabletop front top edge y=23%, lower shelf rear surface y=55%, lower shelf front top edge y=62%, feet bottom y=92%. Keep these same positions to align the app's existing candles and fixed central incense burner. Four legs, empty clear open middle and lower space, complete table inside the transparent margins. Preserve the GUIDE'S alignment, but render REALISTIC crafted materials, not flat guide-color rectangles. Match the room's soft upper-right light, believable natural material detail that reads crisply at a 393px phone width. Do NOT change the two shelf heights or viewpoint for cultural styling. One EMPTY table only: no candle, flower, incense, portrait, bowl, food, text, icons, religious symbols, background, floor or other objects. No baked flames. Chinese hardwood style, rich warm mahogany with elegant simple traditional apron relief detail and straight sturdy legs. Modest fine classical Chinese carving at the upper apron corners, no large ornate motifs. Subtle dark satin sheen, matching the warm wooden memorial room. Both surfaces are wood.
